title: ChatGPT to face tougher regulation in the EU
content:
OpenAI will soon be held accountable for mitigating risks related to ChatGPT’s impact on minors, user mental health, and the spread of illegal content in the European Union. That’s because ChatGPT is now considered a Very Large Online Search Engine under the EU’s Digital Services Act, a set of laws regulating major online services and platforms.
ChatGPT to face tougher regulation in the EU
The EU now considers ChatGPT, Reddit, and Roblox ‘Very Large’ platforms.
Along with ChatGPT, the European Commission also announced that Reddit and Roblox are considered Very Large Online Platforms, subjecting them to the same rules. The DSA restricts platforms from targeting ads to minors or using a person’s sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, or political beliefs. It requires them to provide more transparency about how their recommendation algorithms work, too.
Under the DSA, online platforms and search engines are considered “Very Large” once they reach at least 45 million average monthly users in the EU. ChatGPT, Reddit, and Roblox have until the end of December 2026 to comply with the rules.
“These new designations mean that ChatGPT, Reddit and Roblox will now be held to a higher standard of scrutiny and accountability in the European Union, in line with their large impact on our citizens and society,” Henna Virkkunen, EU executive vice-president for tech sovereignty, security and democracy, says in the announcement.

report.summary: EU designates ChatGPT as Very Large Online Search Engine, subjecting OpenAI to stricter DSA rules on minors, ad targeting, and transparency.
report.background: The EU's Digital Services Act places stricter obligations on online services with more than 45 million average monthly users in the region. ChatGPT now crosses that threshold and has been formally classified as a Very Large Online Search Engine, while Reddit and Roblox are designated Very Large Online Platforms. All three face a compliance deadline of December 2026. The DSA restricts advertising targeting minors and bans use of sensitive personal data such as sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, or political beliefs. It also demands transparency around recommendation algorithms and requires platforms to assess and mitigate systemic risks, including illegal content and serious negative effects on mental health. OpenAI now joins a growing list of major tech companies subject to EU digital oversight.
key_points: ChatGPT is now a Very Large Online Search Engine under the EU's Digital Services Act because it has over 45 million monthly users in the bloc. Reddit and Roblox are designated Very Large Online Platforms. This places all three under stricter EU accountability and scrutiny compared to ordinary tech companies.

The new rules apply from the end of December 2026, giving OpenAI, Reddit, and Roblox roughly two years to implement compliance measures. During this period, they must build systems to handle risk assessments, content moderation, and transparency reporting. Failure to comply can lead to fines up to 6% of global turnover.

The DSA bans targeted advertising to minors and forbids using sensitive personal data like religion, ethnicity, political beliefs, and sexual orientation for ad targeting. ChatGPT must now actively mitigate risks linked to illegal content, minors' exposure, and user mental health — pushing OpenAI to redesign content safeguards and safety protocols for the EU market.

Very Large platforms must explain how recommendation algorithms work. For ChatGPT, this means disclosing how responses are generated, what factors influence outputs, and how users interface with the model. This is a major challenge for OpenAI's closed-source approach, as it requires documenting and potentially auditing proprietary model behavior for EU regulators.
report.impact: This designation signals that generative AI tools are treated as systemic digital services, not just software. OpenAI will have to invest heavily in EU-specific risk assessments, safety evaluations, and transparency reports, with compliance costs likely passed to enterprise API customers. Developers building on ChatGPT will face stricter data handling and audit obligations, possibly affecting product features in the EU. For regular users, the upside is greater transparency about how ChatGPT works and stronger protections for younger users. The downside is potential delays or reduced feature availability in Europe as OpenAI aligns with DSA requirements. Reddit's and Roblox's designations also show that algorithmic feed platforms are increasingly held to similar accountability standards.
report.tools: For ongoing monitoring, check the European Commission's DSA Transparency Database for official compliance filings. OpenAI's system cards and safety evaluations on their public repository show real-world model risks. Developers can use OpenAI's Evals framework (github.com/openai/evals) to test model outputs for harmful or illegal content. Also watch the EU Commission's Digital Strategy pages for enforcement updates and the upcoming AI Act liaisons.
